critters._comment: The crab walks home -> mouth -> via -> a random spot on the open sand, and back the same way. via keeps it on the sandy path out of the cave (clear of the rocks either side). sand_x bounds its whole body (between the dark rocks on the left and the rock beside the cave); sand_y is where its feet stop. walk_speed is px/s; depth_scale grows it slightly per px nearer the viewer than sand_y[0].
